verdict.rationale: The evidence documents Jira automation rules and 'automated reminders' built with Rovo AI, but nothing describes a scheduled or recurring trigger (cron-like or time-interval execution) for jobs or workflows. Event-driven automation and one-off reminders are adjacent features and do not show a recurring schedule, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
